h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, ו׳ Ki Savo, 6
Bikkurim and Shabbos Make Israel Beloved as Children

p: at the beginning of this parsha (Devarim 26:1),
that in the passage of Bikkurim
it is hinted in the word "tene" (basket),
And likewise in the passage of the tithe confession
to be for Him a treasured people."
And we find something like this
that they noted in the Midrash too
"From the beginning of the book until here
the Satan was created with her.
And if a person says to you:
the pasuk is speaking of rivers."
that there is not written, in the passage of Bikkurim
and in the passage of the tithe confession,
according to what they said in the Midrash
"Come and see how endeared they are,
and how much opening of the mouth they have,
אֲבָל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֵינוֹ כֵּן
but the Holy One, Blessed is He, is not so:
a person goes down into his field,
sees a cluster that ripened first, etc.;
I will not move from here
until You fulfill the needs of this day;
is written after the tithe confession,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּיכּוּרִים פֶּרֶק ב מִשְׁנָה ב)
for regarding Bikkurim too it is written:
"And you shall answer and say," etc.,
"and now, behold, I have brought," etc.,
that he has fulfilled Hashem's mitzvah.
"How endeared are those who do mitzvos
before the Holy One, Blessed is He,
for the Holy One, Blessed is He, issues a decree
and the righteous annul it, etc.;
shall know no evil thing,'" etc.
Yisrael are endeared before the Omnipresent:
and in the merit of tithes," etc.
הַיְינוּ עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (תַּעֲנִית יט, א)
that is, in the manner of what they said (Taanis 19a)
who said, "I will not move from here
until You have mercy on Your children";
for you are endearing yourself before the Omnipresent
and He does your will for you,
like a son who endears himself to his father
and he does his will for him";
and it is as it says (Tehillim 123:2):
to the hand of their masters," etc.,
whose strength was in the power of prayer.
whose strength was in the power of Torah,
as in the years of Choni HaMe'agel";
are called children of the Omnipresent,
"and great shall be the peace of your children";
to the passage of the tithe confession:
"that I will not move from here
until You fulfill the needs of this day."
that in the merit of Shabbos
they are endeared before the Omnipresent,
is given the desires of his heart,
and He will give you the desires of your heart,'" etc.
"'May He grant you according to your heart'
for one does not pray so for every person,
there is in a person's heart
his heart was whole before his Creator,
to rectify all the corruption of the serpent,
all the desires of his heart,
for then his heart is whole before his Creator.
where it is written "and you shall rejoice in all the good,"
all the corruption of the serpent,
so that there be no admixture of evil,
all the desires of his heart.
And so it expounds regarding tithes,
and He will give you the desires of your heart";
for it expounds all the pesukim
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן מִתְחַטֵּא לִפְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם
and he too is endeared before the Omnipresent,
like a son who endears himself to his father,

for the letter Samech indicates the Satan,
is like a son before the Omnipresent,
there is no Satan or accusation at all;
to accuse the son before his father?
And surely He would not listen to his accusation.
And the first Samech in this parsha
to be for Him a treasured people."
is said in the name of our master the holy Yehudi,
may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing:
that it is like a segulah, a charm,
and this is what it says (Shemos 19:5):
"and you shall be to Me a treasure
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (מַלְאָכִי א, ב)
And it is in the manner of what it says (Malachi 1:2):
"Is not Esav a brother to Yaakov," etc.,
in the manner of what they said (Tanchuma Tzav 2):
He wraps himself in his tallis like an elder
"From there I will bring you down, says Hashem."
for Hashem Yisbarach testifies about Yisrael
that they are bound at the root
and cannot be severed, Heaven forbid,
"It is revealed and known before You
that our will is to do Your will";
and this is only like a segulah,
And this is what is hinted in this parsha,
in that the letter Samech is not said
and in the passage of the tithe confession,
for it alludes to the Satan:
that in the merit of Bikkurim and tithes
there is no Satan or accusation at all.
Only it is mentioned in the word "segulah,"
and to be like a segulah
as the Shechinah dwelling in the land
"And the children of Yisrael shall keep
and it says in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 48):
who makes for them a dwelling on Shabbos
in the two chambers of the heart,
and there is cleared out from there
as is written in the holy Zohar;
and it is written after it:
and He will give you the desires of your heart,"
which is expounded in the Gemara (Shabbos 118b):
I do not know what it is, etc.;
this is the delight of Shabbos."
there is no accusation at all,
and he is given all the desires of his heart,

p: in the Baal HaTurim mentioned above
which correspond to the three holy Names
שֶׁהֵם נֶגֶד ג׳ סְעוּדוֹת שֶׁל שַׁבָּת
which correspond to the three meals of Shabbos,
as in our words (in the previous maamar).
alludes to the aspect of the supernal "pele" (wonder),
which is the root of the source,
and it is the Name Ekyeh.
alludes to the holiness of the Name Havayah;
alludes to "the light, that it was good,"
And the light is the revelation of the Name Havayah,
And therefore they hinted in Bereishis Rabbah (3:5)
as the five books of the Torah;
for it itself is the light of Torah,
for "the Torah and the Holy One, Blessed is He, are one";
and Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for this Name,
and it is the attribute of truth,
And this is the aspect of
the illumination of the truth of Havayah,
שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which is the aspect of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him.
which is the aspect of Knesses Yisrael,
that is, the totality of the souls of Yisrael.
"She has fallen, she shall no more rise,
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה
And about this our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said
that Nun is not mentioned in Ashrei
David went back and supported them
And this is precisely in the letter Samech
the allusion of support for the fall;
עַל סוֹד ה׳ לִירִיאָיו (תְּהִלִּים כה, יד)
to "the secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him" (Tehillim 25:14).
And it is like the matter
that we heard from our holy Rebbe of Izhbitza,
may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
in the name of a certain Rav,
that the root of the creation of the locust
is from all twenty-two letters of the Torah,
and the root of the locust
And therefore there is said with this plague
"so that you may tell in the ears of your son";
in the aspect of the opposite,
so through their being smitten with this plague,
whose root is the letter Samech,
in "the secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him":
"so that you may tell in the ears of your son...
how I made a mockery of Egypt."
For in Yoel it says about the locust (Yoel 2:20):
I will remove far from you";
and schemes in secret against a person's heart
so that he not recognize it,
כְּעִנְיַן אֲמָרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (חוּלִּין צא, א)
as in their saying, of blessed memory (Chullin 91a),
regarding Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him:
"he appeared to him as a talmid chacham";
that is, he disguises himself before a person
that his intent is for the sake of Heaven,
through the aspect of "Binah is the heart,"
which is in the inwardness of the point in the heart;
which You have hidden for those who fear You,"
and this is "the secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him."
the eighth of the ten plagues,
which correspond to the ten attributes,
corresponds to the attribute of "Binah is the heart";
the inwardness of the point of the heart,
and through this there is subdued
the hidden one in the heart,
and there comes about support for the fall
through "the secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him."
